title: Raise research dispatch caps (github_runner 3->6, runner-pool in-flight 5->8) ONLY if the CI-DIET 24 h p90 of concurrent CI jobs stays <= 10
note: [2026-10-14 weekly planning] OPERATOR-APPROVED 2026-10-14, CONDITIONAL. Field read 2026-10-14 (scripts/research/research_compute.yaml): backends.github_runner.max_concurrent 3, github_runner_data.max_concurrent 2 (runner pool 3+2 = 5), limits.max_total_inflight 7; the 2026-10-13 CAP MEASUREMENT (population: 4,176 runs, 288 5-min buckets) found CI p90 16 concurrent and the ~20 pool binding, so the caps were NOT raised then. CI-DIET (landed_unproven) trims the PR suite for data-only PRs; the condition is a 24 h re-measurement with the same method showing CI p90 <= 10. If it holds: github_runner 3->6 and the runner-pool in-flight 5->8 (max_total_inflight moves with it), one PR citing the measurement. If it does not hold: note the reading here and leave the caps. [2026-10-15 lane RESEARCH-CAPS-RAISE] 24h RE-MEASUREMENT, CONDITION NOT MET -> caps LEFT (github_runner 3, runner pool 3+2, max_total_inflight 8 unchanged). Method: per-minute concurrent CI-class workflow runs (event pull_request|push, name not research) from the Actions API, run_started_at..updated_at, window 2026-10-14T06:18Z..10-15T06:18Z, population 5,774 runs created (2,872 CI, 229 research, 2,673 other: schedule/dispatch/etc), 1,440 one-minute buckets. CI p50 4 / p90 17 / p99 37 / max 53; research p90 4; all-workload p90 21. Last 12h alone: CI p90 20, all p90 26. Needs p90<=10; reads 17 (CI-DIET's post-merge 8 came from a 50-min window; it did not hold over a full day). Run-level not job-level (a run holds >=1 job), so job-level concurrency is >= these. Caveat: 'other' max 210 is likely stale in-progress runs, excluded from the CI figure. Next re-measure after the CI p90 driver is found (what is running 17-20 CI runs at once); due_by 2026-10-21 unchanged.

observation.what: a 24 h re-measurement (same method as the 2026-10-13 CAP MEASUREMENT) is recorded here; if CI p90 <= 10 the caps read github_runner 6 / runner-pool in-flight 8 on main and the following 24 h shows no CI queue wait regression; otherwise the caps stay and the reading is noted
observation.how_to_check: scripts/research/research_compute.yaml on main + the measurement block in its header + comms/research/utilization
